title: Anniversary and Important-Date Countdown
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=keptintouch:contact event=important_date
| eval days_to=round((date_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to>=0 AND days_to<=30
| sort days_to
description: Counts down to anniversaries, birthdays, and other important dates so none catches you unprepared.
value: Forgetting an important date is a needless own-goal; an early countdown gives time to plan something thoughtful.
implementation: Log important dates into `index=personal`; surface those coming up within a month.
visualization: Table of upcoming important dates by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It counts down to anniversaries and birthdays so you never forget an important date again.
